## Checklist

**For everyone**

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [ ] This PR does one thing
- [ ] I ran `npm run format` (Prettier)
- [ ] I agree my contribution is licensed under CC BY 4.0 (content) and MIT (code)

**Content changes**

- [ ] Written in simple English and follows the [style guide](../docs/CONTENT-STYLE-GUIDE.md)
- [ ] New words are explained, facts are checked and any illustrative numbers are labelled
- [ ] It is safe, legal and defensive (no attacks on real targets, no working malware)
- [ ] Front matter is complete and lessons end with a **Remember** section
- [ ] The text is my own, or properly credited and compatible with CC BY 4.0

**Code changes**

- [ ] `npm run format:check`, `npm run check:content`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] I tried it on a wide and a narrow screen, and with the keyboard
- [ ] No new dependencies (or I discussed them in an issue first)
- [ ] No tracking, accounts or network calls added
